simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֵצֶר (H5342) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נֵצֶר (nêtser) means a shoot ; figuratively, a descendant First listed occurrence: Dan 11 7.

definitions.full: H5342. netser נֵ֫צְר noun masculine sprout, shoot , in figurative uses: — absolute ׳נ Isa 11:1 ; 14:19 (simile); construct 60:21 ( ׳נ מַטָּעַי ), Dan 11:7 ( ׳מִנּ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ ; but ᵐ5 Bev 'possibly' ׳נ מִשֶּׁרָשֶׁיהָ ).
definitions.rootNote: from 5341 in the sense of greenness as a striking color;
